result.summary: Found several layout and content clipping issues: restaurant names truncated in the horizontal carousel, a profile notification without a badge count, and a large empty gap above the bottom tab bar.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' row are truncated/cut off (e.g. 'Trattoria Piccol' is incomplete) even though card width appears fixed.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards and text containers expand/ellipsis consistently so full names remain readable.

issues.description: Large empty white space between the last visible content (pizza card) and the bottom tab bar, making the layout feel sparse or broken.
issues.suggestion: Tighten vertical spacing or ensure the next content section flows closer to the tab bar without an oversized gap.

issues.description: Top-right profile avatar shows only a small red dot with no numeric badge or clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a proper notification badge with count if there are alerts, or remove the orphaned red dot for a cleaner header.

issues.description: Category chips row ends with a partially visible empty/white chip on the far right, which can look like a styling glitch beyond intentional peek.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal padding and chip spacing so the peek of the next chip looks intentional, or hide overflow more cleanly.
